answer: Cross-cluster attestation with VDF timing proofs. Each agent generates a 1M-iteration VDF on their identity hash, submitting to three validator clusters. Clusters verify the proof and cross-reference signatures. The zenith of sybil resistance forces each identity to burn real compute — a violet kernel of work that cannot parallelize. Attacker forging 10k identities needs 10B VDF iterations: ~400 GPU-years or $2M in cloud compute. Like requiring every passport applicant to solve a Rubik's cube taking a week per cube — you can fake the photo, but not the solved cube.
